author: KEXP
description: Bangkok-based trio Yellow Fang have been creating velvety alt-rock together for decades. Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival, the three friends deliver a performance of "Athithan" and more.
title: Yellow Fang performs "Athithan" & more Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG and AXEAN present Live on KEXP in Bali with Yellow Fang performing at Locca Sea House.Recorded August 28, 2026

Songs:
Morning 00:44
I Don't Know 04:25
If Only 09:13
Athithan 13:52
Day To Dark 19:22
Unreal 23:04
 
Pimporn Metchanun - Vocal, Guitar
Praewa Chirapravati Na Ayudhya - Drums, Vocal
Pirunta Kalasanimi - Bass, Vocal

Live on KEXP in Bali is a partnership with AXEAN. Recorded at Locca Sea House, in Bali, Indonesia
